qcd.og:title: 🌈 Quantum Chromodynamics — An Interactive Descent | Ferray × WASM
qcd.og:description: Colour charge, gluon self-coupling, confinement, asymptotic freedom, the non-empty vacuum, and a theory whose mathematical existence is an open problem. Every picture is a labelled cartoon — and the labels get worse as the physics gets better.
qcd.twitter:title: 🌈 Quantum Chromodynamics — An Interactive Descent | Ferray × WASM
qcd.twitter:description: The strong force, from 'quarks are held by springs' to 'the perturbation series does not converge'. Picture honesty: 78% → 4%.

objects.og:description: An interactive folio of torus knot, Klein bottle, Möbius strip, spherical harmonic and supershape — plus a catoid wrapped around them, with an animated tail and a Cheshire grin. Three.js + Threlte, four material presets.
objects.twitter:title: 🧊 Object Folio — Eight Three.js Objects and One Very Long Cat
objects.twitter:description: Orbit, spin and wireframe eight Three.js shapes — and the catoid that laps them.
